verdicts.originalText: Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm tick markers are rendered for the full 20s window, but in-game the ticks only fire once Opal Fire activates (when Nightsoul points reach 50). Citlali starts at 24 points after the cast and accumulates the rest via team-Cryo / A4 Frozen-Melt regen, so the planner over-shows ticks during the early portion. Resource-pool gating not modelled per the constitution.
verdicts.proposedText: Tick markers are shown across the full window, but in game they only start once Nightsoul reaches 50 and Opal Fire activates — so the early ticks are over-shown while points build up.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the summon's tick markers span the whole window, but in game the storm only emits once Nightsoul reaches the Opal Fire threshold, so early ticks are over-shown. This is a resource-pool gap (windows, not gauges) on the CANNOT list, so it stays a rewrite. Compressed to the divergence itself; stripped the character name, fixed 'modelled'->'modeled', dropped 'rendered'/'planner' in favor of 'shown'/'timeline' voice, and demoted the point-accumulation mechanics and constitution reasoning to curator notes.

claimsLost.claim: Starts at 24 Nightsoul points after the cast and accumulates the rest via team-Cryo application and A4 Frozen/Melt regen
Resource-pool gating not modeled per the constitution

demotedNotes: Nightsoul starts at 24 after the cast and builds toward the 50-point Opal Fire threshold via team-Cryo application and the A4 Frozen/Melt Nightsoul regen. Per the constitution (windows, not gauges) the Nightsoul resource pool is not modeled; the flat 20s window approximates maximum possible Itzpapa activity.
